data_design: All conditions same expanded action space. Nominal and recovery initial cohorts use 48 successful attempted slots; recovery uses 24 shared nominal and 24 single-perturbation starts. Aggregation adds up to24 fixed-prefix student-visited teacher recovery tails; compare an equally sized additional scripted recovery data control. Report exclusions and sample counts, do not replace failures silently. Pilot data never train. Final conditions never seed aggregation.
heldout_region_screen: Training trajectories excluded if teacher-labeled state has |yaw|>3deg AND (|y|>8mm OR remaining x>0.33m OR remaining x<-3mm). Audit coverage and do not claim unseen combinations if this screen is violated.
selection: Checkpoint only development loss/ready mistakes; no final test retuning. Final test run after all checkpoints fixed.
boundary: No truth-gated grasp or teacher fallback during independent student evaluation; privileged takeover is training-only.
